Definition: to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (i.e. seem)
BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is to see, to behold, and it carries the visions of Daniel. The king sees a great image whose brightness is terrible, he sees a stone cut out without hands smite it, and he sees four men loose in the furnace, the fourth like the Son of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what Nebuchadnezzar saw is what God wanted him to see: an image that falls and a fourth man in the fire. Seeing is the gift here, and God gives it to a pagan king.
RelatedEvents: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image; Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
